title: Adjoint reductions of tangent bundles of spheres
summary: We study reductions of the tangent bundle of $S^{\dim G}$ through the adjoint representation of a compact connected Lie group $G$. If $d=\dim G$ and $r=\operatorname{rank} G$, we show that the adjoint map $\operatorname{Ad}\colon G\longrightarrow \mathrm{SO}(d)$ is homotopic, as an ordinary map, to one with values in $\mathrm{SO}(d-r+1)$. It follows that every vector bundle over a sphere associated to a principal $G$-bundle via the adjoint representation admits $r-1$ linearly independent sections.
